checks.name: kit verified before anything runs (pill ok)
checks.observed: Kit verified · trust key 4c7716c7…0244 (bundled with the kit)

checks.name: meaning panel visible before Validate
checks.observed: Each record gives, for one SKU: NAME exactly as written; PRICE_VND as a positive whole number copied exactly (leading zeros removed, no currency conversion); QTY_ON_HAND as physical unsold units on hand, including units currently reserved by shop orders — not "available to sell" and not a change (+/−). An accepted file replaces the whole supplier snapshot.

invalid kit fixture → Rejected (record level) banner
checks.observed: Rejected — no snapshot was produced. 4 of 4 records need correction (6 problems). Nothing in the shop or in any earlier export was changed. Partial acceptance is not available: correct the listed records and validate the whole file again.

checks.name: one card per rejected record (4), in record order

observed.head: Record 3 · spreadsheet row 4 · SKU notebook
rows: SKU must be 1–32 characters from A–Z, 0–9, "-" and "_". Lowercase is not converted automatically. Rule: Use 1–32 uppercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore
Use digits 0–9 only: no spaces, signs, decimal points, exponents or thousands separators. Rule: Expected a positive bounded decimal integer

observed.head: Record 4 · spreadsheet row 5 · SKU TOTE
rows: Number is larger than 9007199254740991, the largest supported value. Rule: Expected a positive bounded decimal integer

corrected file → Accepted banner

accepted exports are new run-ID-named files
